The response completely fails to adopt the requested persona of Sheldon Cooper. It delivers a generic, balanced, corporate-style summary of hand dryer pros and cons without any of Sheldon's distinctive speech patterns, pedantic precision, germaphobic tendencies, condescension, or specific scientific citations. The instruction explicitly asked to "embrace the role" and avoid starting with "As Sheldon," yet the answer reads like a standard customer service FAQ. There is no creativity, character work, or adherence to the roleplay constraint.

Rating: [[2]]
